findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Topology/VectorBundle/Basic.lean:270` `def coordChangeL`; `:294` `coe_coordChangeL … = (e.linearEquivAt R b hb.1).symm.trans (e'.linearEquivAt R b hb.2)`; `Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/LocalFrame.lean:333` `def basisAt (hx : x ∈ e.baseSet) : Basis ι 𝕜 (V x) := b.map (e.linearEquivAt (R := 𝕜) x hx).symm`. With these, `(e'.basisAt b hx').toMatrix (e.basisAt b hx) i j = b.repr (coordChangeL 𝕜 e e' x (b j)) i = LinearMap.toMatrix b b _ i j` in a few lines. The tangent identification is `Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Tangent.lean:143` `abbrev tangentCoordChange (x y) := (tangentBundleCore I M).coordChange (achart H x) (achart H y)`, `:90` `indexAt := achart H`, and `Mathlib/Topology/FiberBundle/Basic.lean`/`Mathlib/Topology/VectorBundle/Basic.lean:794` `trivializationAt_coordChange_eq`.
findings.fix: Prove the general form in `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/LocalFrame.lean`, whose variable block already has `[VectorBundle 𝕜 F V]`, `{e : Trivialization F (TotalSpace.proj …)} [MemTrivializationAtlas e]` and `(b : Basis ι 𝕜 F)` — add a second `e'` — then derive `tangentCoordChange_toMatrix` by rewriting with `VectorBundleCore.trivializationAt_coordChange_eq` (via `ContinuousLinearMap.ext`), which identifies `(trivializationAt E (TangentSpace I) α).coordChangeL 𝕜 (trivializationAt E (TangentSpace I) β) x` with `tangentCoordChange I α β x`.
findings.issue: `tangentCoordChange_toMatrix` fixes the tangent bundle and the preferred trivializations, but the statement is bundle-generic: for any vector bundle and any two atlas trivializations `e e'` with `x ∈ e.baseSet ∩ e'.baseSet`, `LinearMap.toMatrix b b (e.coordChangeL 𝕜 e' x).toLinearMap = (e'.basisAt b hx').toMatrix (e.basisAt b hx)`. Stated only for `trivializationAt … (TangentSpace I)`, the general fact is unavailable to any other bundle (e.g. the Riemannian/hom bundles already used in this repo).

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/Tangent.lean:146-147`: `lemma tangentCoordChange_def {x y z : M} : tangentCoordChange I x y z = fderivWithin 𝕜 (extChartAt I y ∘ (extChartAt I x).symm) (range I) (extChartAt I x z) := rfl`.
findings.fix: Drop `chartVolumeDensity_changeCoordinates`; keep `chartVolumeDensity_changeChart` and prove `chartVolumeDensity_comp_symm_changeCoordinates` from it with `rw [tangentCoordChange_def]`. The coordinate-domain form is the one that genuinely changes the hypotheses and is worth keeping.
findings.issue: `chartVolumeDensity_changeCoordinates` has a statement definitionally equal to `chartVolumeDensity_changeChart` (its proof is `simpa only [tangentCoordChange_def]`, and `tangentCoordChange_def` is proved by `rfl`). Two public theorems at the same generality with the same content is duplicated surface with no added strength.

summary: The new matrix lemma is stated for the tangent bundle's preferred trivializations although its content is generic vector-bundle material (`Trivialization.coordChangeL` versus `basisAt`), and the volume-density module publishes a definitionally identical restatement of its own main theorem.
